export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/nippon-paint-india-private-limited) — exact row: "2026-02-28 | NIPPON PAINT (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | GULF EXPRESS COMPANY FOR CAR | N-MAX SB EU81X HIGH GLNT MIRROR MAGIC 1L(PAINTPAINT ANCILLARIES)- | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Shuaiba, KUWAIT | 32089090 | 1137929". Counter vs rows seen: page header states "Total Shipments 15264 Records detected", "Trading Partners 116", "Ports 103", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; only 5 shipment rows were actually rendered in the free view (4 export rows to Kuwait + 1 import row from China), so 5 of 15,264 rows verified. Export destinations visible in buyer/supplier tables: Kuwait (Gulf Express Company for Car), UAE (NPME Nippon Paints & Coatings, Nippon Paint Middle East FZE), Indonesia (PT NP Auto Refinishes), Kenya (Nipsea Paint Kenya Ltd), Nepal (Ruchi Trading Pvt Ltd). HS on the verified export rows is 32089090 (paints/varnishes), NOT the declared 390690.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India revenue split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and the registry pages tried (tofler.in, thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com) returned 404/403. The company website https://www.nipponpaint.co.in/about-us/ contains only corporate/marketing text ("After over ten years in the Indian market, Nippon Paint is steadily becoming a household name") — a claim, not supply evidence, so it is not counted. Domestic turnover: null (not public in accessible sources).
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: B/L 1137929, dated 2026-02-28, Nhava Sheva Sea (INNSA1) -> Shuaiba, Kuwait, consignee Gulf Express Company for Car, HS 32089090. Additional export lanes appear in the counterparty tables (UAE, Indonesia, Kenya, Nepal) but those individual rows were not rendered in the free view, so they are recorded as seen-in-counter only. HS discrepancy: declared 390690 (acrylic polymers) vs actual 32089090 on the verified export rows — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the factual code is 32089090. Note the same ImportKey page also shows this entity as a large IMPORTER (e.g. 2026-02-28 from NP Materials Shanghai Co. Ltd, Qingdao -> Chennai Sea, HS 39123929, B/L 7805102), i.e. it is both a manufacturer and a trader of coatings raw materials. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified within the tool budget — status unknown, not 'none_found'; absence of retrieved data is not proof of absence. Revenue/domestic turnover left null rather than estimated. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were assessed here (out of scope for this role).
